title: Death Stranding
provenance: Reported working by detnarrrrrrrrr (highball#107, 2026-09-15), Apple M5, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.9.19, Epic copy, D3DMetal with AVX advertised. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: DirectX 12, so D3DMetal. The game refuses to start without AVX ("Death Stranding requires a CPU with AVX support", highball#107 on an M5), which Rosetta hides unless asked, so the recipe advertises it to the game. Confirmed by the reporter on an M5 with Highball 0.9.19.

nativeMac.note: A native Director's Cut exists on the Mac App Store (macOS 13.3, M1 or later), but it is a separate purchase: a Steam copy will not launch it.

knownIssues.symptom: "Death Stranding requires a CPU with AVX support" at launch (reported on an M5)
knownIssues.fix: the recipe advertises AVX to the game (ROSETTA_ADVERTISE_AVX=1), or the Compatibility switch in Environment settings

knownIssues.symptom: "failed to load d3d12.dll" with exception C06D007F right after the AVX check (reported on an M5, Epic copy, Highball 0.9.15)
knownIssues.cause: measured on Path of Exile 2 and Hogwarts Legacy the same day: the DirectX 12 timestamp shim numbered its exports from 1 and the game binds D3D12CreateDevice by ordinal 101
knownIssues.fix: Highball 0.9.19 and its engines r3 and r9. Confirmed by the reporter
